title: Money Forward Vietnam: candidate experience and employer brand
summary: A digital experience for candidates, built around the hiring journey and the employer brand of a fintech company.

blocks.text: Money Forward Vietnam needed a place where candidates could understand what the company does, what its culture is like and which role suits them, before deciding to apply.

items: Candidates need clear information about roles, locations and the hiring process.
The employer brand must be consistent with the product brand.
Content must be easy to update as hiring needs change.

blocks.text: I led content and experience: information structure, brand storytelling, and the writing for each step of the candidate journey, working with the client's design, engineering and HR teams.

items: From learning about the company and browsing roles to submitting an application.
A consistent voice and message across all pages.
Job pages structured so the HR team can update them on its own.

blocks.alt: Illustration: the careers page and job listing
blocks.caption: Illustration: the careers page and job listing

items: For candidates, clarity matters more than polish.
The employer brand is part of the product and should be designed as a journey.
